_readme: Default template (ruler) for the building type. Spec: prompts/PDF2BIM_VECTOR_PROBE.md §33. The structure is PRESET and orientation is PRESUMED; the code only fills the blanks from the sheets. Edit for another drafter's set of the same type.

envelope.ring: closed ring of walls on the grid axes
envelope.openings: doors D1..D3 and windows W1..W3, sizes from the p8 schedule, positions from the plan

views._presumed: Orientation is presumed, not inferred (owner 2026-11-04). row = which of the sheet's two views. axis = the grid line of the wall that face shows.

beam_above_ffl.read_from: elevations: the long line above the floor line

ffl_above_ground.read_from: elevations: floor line above the ground line

ridge_above_beam.read_from: side elevations: top of the highest line at the roof's pitch

eaves_from_axis.read_from: roof plan: where the sheet ribs end, from the outer axes

wall_thickness.read_from: plan: gap between paired wall pen lines

porch_step_below_ffl.read_from: front elevation: the line between floor and ground
